top_strength: Despite the customer declining the virtual walkthrough for this 3,200 sqft destination home, Danah smoothly pivoted to a thorough room-by-room phone inventory — shed contents, garage capacity and packing level, appliances, and a box-count estimate — gathering enough detail to still build an estimate without the video call.
coaching_note: The destination home is two stories, but Danah never asked about stairs or access there — a real driver of the hourly estimate — and she closed the call without mentioning No Worries Damage Coverage, so the customer has nothing about protection on file before the emailed estimate arrives.
phone_presence_notes: Patient through the customer's hearing trouble and used her name a few times, but most of the call was brief transactional acknowledgments ("okay, got it," "mm-hmm") rather than genuine warmth or rapport.
